item.title: US loses measles elimination status amid worst outbreak since 1991
item.description:
UNITED STATES—A scientific triumph that quietly shaped a generation, the United States’ measles-elimination status passed away on Tuesday, November 17, 2026. Hailed as an unmitigated good and a borderline miracle on its initial appearance, then quickly forgotten, Measles Elimination had seemed to have many more good years ahead of it. Its decline was sudden and dramatic, and it had been feuding with the secretary of health and human services for some time, although he denied having any direct role in its demise. Observers described its death as “senseless,” “utterly senseless,” “an enormous step backward,” and “the kind of thing that makes you lose all hope in human progress.” Measles Elimination arrived in 2000 as the proud work of scientists and doctors and public messaging. item.title: Measles Is Officially Back
